correctness.rationale: Every weight-three cross-bifix-free codeword must be primitive: proper period produces a nontrivial border. Distinct codewords cannot be distinct rotations (one rotation yields a cross prefix/suffix overlap). The number of primitive weight-three necklaces is [binom(n,3)-1_(3|n)*n/3]/n = floor((n-1)(n-2)/6). Proposed C_n has ones at 0,a,b with 1<=a<=floor(n/3)=k and a<b<=n-k-1. All proper suffixes either start at 0 (cannot if proper), start at b and contain one 1 while comparable prefixes contain >=2, or start at a and contain two 1s while comparable prefixes contain three; suffixes starting at zeros cannot match prefixes starting at one. Its cardinality sums to exact upper bound for n mod 3=0,1,2. Every primitive cyclic gap triple has at least one short and one long gap and a unique long-to-short transition (the gap sequence has length 3), selecting exactly the canonical C_n representative. Independent direct generation checked cardinality/nonoverlap/necklace-one-representative for each n=4..34, including n divisible by 3; infinity follows from the gap proof.
